notes: Stored edit with one storage choice: the Twin Towers stored in Frankfurt by name (w1) or as the bank's headquarters building (w2, a rule over headquartered_in). Since 2026-10-31 'the towers are Deutsche Bank's headquarters building' is background (towers_hq: the bank is headquartered in the city the towers stand in), and w1 gives it up, the side fact the record's w1 lists (the towers stop being the headquarters building; FINDINGS A5). w2 keeps it, which changes nothing there. q3 ('same city as the ECB') is a join: the towers' city is the ECB's headquarters city (headquartered_in is functional); the ECB in Frankfurt is q3's bridge and 'the towers stand in one city' (one_city) the presupposition, both firm. Relabelled dl on 2026-10-31 (COVERAGE.md label corrections); the fol section keeps its Z3 encoding as a second check.

queries.ask: towers : located_in some (City and inv(headquartered_in) value ecb)

fol.notes: One uninterpreted sort for organisations, buildings and places; headquartered_in is a function (RELATIONS.md: functional). As the DL file: the towers are in Frankfurt by name (w1) or wherever the bank's headquarters is (w2); towers_hq (the bank is headquartered in the city the towers stand in) is background that w1 gives up (the side fact the record's w1 lists). 'Same city' needs the towers to stand in one city (firm) and the named cities to be distinct.

kinds.says: Frankfurt and Munich are two different cities.

one_city.says: A building stands in one city.
one_city.z3: ForAll([c, d], Implies(And(city(c), city(d), located_in(towers, c), located_in(towers, d)), c == d))

ecb_frankfurt.says: The European Central Bank is headquartered in Frankfurt. (stored)

towers_hq.says: The Deutsche Bank Twin Towers are Deutsche Bank's headquarters building: the bank is headquartered in the city the towers stand in.
towers_hq.z3: ForAll(c, Implies(And(city(c), located_in(towers, c)), headquartered_in(deutsche_bank) == c))

queries.ask: Exists(c, And(city(c), located_in(towers, c), headquartered_in(ecb) == c))
